Job Title: RTOS Software Engineer
 Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Type: Permanent
 Our client are a Physical AI company looking for Engineers to work on-site in Bucharest.
 Key Responsibilities
 Design, implement, and optimize real-time firmware on an RTOS, tuning for latency, jitter, and CPU/memory footprint.
 Develop task scheduling, IPC, synchronization, device drivers, and middleware.
 Port and configure the RTOS for new SoCs and boards.
 Debug complex real-time and concurrency issues, including race conditions and priority inversion.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with platform, DSP, and application engineering teams.
 Requirements:
 BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science.
 5+ years of embedded firmware development in C on RTOS-based systems.
 Deep understanding of real-time scheduling, concurrency, synchronization, and microcontroller/SoC architecture (memory, interrupts, DMA).
 Experience with at least one major RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX, or QNX) and Linux kernel driver development.
 Strong hardware debugging skills using JTAG/SWD, trace, and lab instruments.
 Desirables:
 Experience with ARM Cortex-M/R architectures and multi-core AMP/SMP RTOS configurations.
 Background in low-latency, high-rate sensor data pipelines.
 Familiarity with safety-critical or functional-safety (ISO 26262) firmware requirements.
 Background in robotics or autonomous systems.
 If this sounds of interest, please reach out to daniel@microtech-global.com for more information
